candidates.place_reason: 306d audit 2026-10-13: the 6 anchors are a uniform 0.378 m/px rectangle (rot 0, resid 21.8-31.8 m), but that is 2.6x the plate's own bar (its five ticks span 623 px for 300 ft = 0.147 m/px; independent check: the drawn round tower circle, 54.5 px, is 8.0 m at the bar's scale - matching the plate's text '28 feet in diameter inside, with walls 4 feet' - but 20.6 m at the stored fit, 2x the stated ~11 m outer). The centre is ~right - the drawn rounded W curtain + hatched buildings sit ON the real hatched 12th-c core at the site point - but the drawn outer enclosure (~315x340 m, centred E +151 / N -60) is bigger than the real cliff-top complex (aerial: grassland ~230 m E-W x 165 m N-S, centred ~40 m E of the site point): the drawn E wall runs ~150 m beyond the real grassland over the town blocks (Brewery Yard / Linney Villa side) and the drawn S wall ~140 m over the town near the Wye. Goodrich class: centred ~right, drawn works bigger than the real complex, walls through the town. Document deleted.
candidates.why: line check: fabricated anchor pattern: grid-round page coordinates (5 of 5 distinct values on a 10-px grid); the gate's 22.4 m measures internal consistency of the anchors, not their truth
